### Must fix before opening

**#1 · P2 · bugs · CONFIRMED** — `apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx:42`
- **What:** `data-indeterminate:[&>svg]:hidden` hides the only glyph, and nothing takes its place.
- **Why:** In base-ui 1.2.0 an indeterminate checkbox never gets `data-checked` (`useStateAttributesMapping.js:9-11`). The Root at line 35 has no `data-indeterminate:` styles either, so there is no fill or border change. The result is a plain grey box that looks exactly like an unchecked one.
- **Who sees it:** `SelectAllToggle.tsx:53` passes `indeterminate` for the "some selected" state. That component is used in the Spaces onboarding flow (`OnboardingSafesList.tsx:34-35`). With some safes selected, the "Select all" box looks the same as with none selected. Screen readers are fine because `aria-checked="mixed"` is still set.
- **Fix:** Render a dash for indeterminate. For example, add `<MinusIcon />` from lucide (already used in `input-otp.tsx`) next to `CheckIcon`, and toggle each with `data-indeterminate:` / `not-data-indeterminate:`. Also add `data-indeterminate:bg-primary data-indeterminate:border-primary data-indeterminate:text-primary-foreground` to the Root so the box reads as selected. If design really wants an empty box for this state, say so in WA-2387 and in the PR.
- **Adjudication:** the validator CONFIRMED it (90) and the refuter found nothing against it (STANDS). The refuter found no global `[data-indeterminate]` CSS and no consumer that overrides the style.

Nothing would catch this state going blank or wrong again. Add an `Indeterminate` story that Chromatic snapshots. (Only one agent looked at this, so it isn't scored.) |

- I used the base-ui source from `/Users/valentin/Development/safe/wallet-1/node_modules` (1.2.0, the version in the lockfile) because this worktree has no `node_modules`.
- I ran the nine area passes myself instead of starting nine reviewer agents, because the diff is one line. Only #1 went through the two-agent check.
- No cleanup proposals: the change is too small to justify any.
- `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv` wasn't written, because you asked for no file changes. That means there's no "since your last run" comparison next time.

2. `apps/web/src/components/ui/stories/checkbox.stories.tsx:36`: the story has no indeterminate state, so nothing catches a visual regression there. P3, only one agent checked it.
